description:
Finish tools for the Draftless AI creative studio. Requires sign-in to run. Actions:
- composite_video: Assemble several video, image and audio clips into ONE finished MP4, rendered server-side.
- get_composite_status: Check a composite render submitted with `composite_video`.
- composite_text_on_video: Burn text onto an existing MP4 — captions, titles, watermarks, lower-thirds — and get back a durable file.
- get_overlay_status: Check a text-overlay job submitted with `composite_text_on_video` a finish job submitted with `apply_finish`, or a speed-ramp / deflicker jo
- apply_finish: Give an existing clip a finished, shot-on-a-camera feel and a proper delivery encode.
- apply_music_bed: Lay a music track UNDER an existing MP4's own audio (voiceover, native speech) and get back the same video with mixed sound — what composite
- transcribe_audio: Transcribe a public audio or video URL (≤25 MB, ≤ ~30 min) into text with timed segments (start/end seconds).
- generate_captions: Transcribe a public audio or video URL and return timed captions in SRT, WebVTT, or JSON.
- create_faceless_package: Write YouTube packaging for a narrated video: title options, description, tags, chapters snapped to shot boundaries, and thumbnail concepts.

input.description: Arguments for the action (see discover.describe_action once signed in).

name: finish
